data.description: Strategically located between Port Rashid and Dubai Drydocks World, Dubai Maritime City is designed to be a comprehensive hub for all maritime-related activities.

data.answer: With ongoing development and the government's focus on enhancing maritime activities, Dubai Maritime City is set to become a more prominent player in Dubai’s urban landscape. The integration of residential buildings with commercial and leisure facilities is expected to foster a dynamic community atmosphere.

Various developers have secured rights to develop empty plots within the Harbour Residences and Harbour Offices areas of Dubai Maritime City (DMC). They are in the process of constructing residential and mixed-use towers, which include developments such as ANWA by Omniyat, Nautica by Select Group, Oceanz by Danube Properties, The Pier Residence, Coral Reef by DAMAC Properties, Mar Casa by Deyaar Development, Burj Al Mena by Vakson Group Limited, and Harbour Lights De Grisogono Geneve by DAMAC Properties. With the exception of ANWA by Omniyat, all these properties are being offered as off-plan apartment buildings. Upon completion, Dubai Maritime City will feature an extensive range of apartment options, including studios and 1, 2, 3, and 4-bedroom units in various sizes and configurations.

Buying a Property in Dubai Maritime City

Due to the numerous buildings under construction in the area, there is a wide variety of off-plan apartments for sale in Dubai Maritime City. Those interested can also consider purchasing a penthouse in Dubai Maritime City. The cost of purchasing a studio apartment starts at AED 750k. For 1-bedroom flats, prices begin at AED 1.1M. The sale price for a 2-bedroom apartment starts at AED 1.85M. A 3-bedroom flat can be bought for a minimum of AED 2.39M, while the starting price for a 4-bedroom unit is AED 3.3M.

Rental Properties in Dubai Maritime City

Renting a studio apartment in Dubai Maritime City costs at least AED 74k per year. For a 1-bedroom unit, the annual rent is approximately AED 90k. The minimum rent for a 2-bedroom flat in Dubai Maritime City is AED 140k per year.

*Please note that rental and sales prices are subject to change and may vary over time. It is advisable to check current rates and availability with the relevant property agents or landlords.

more_info.question: What’s Life Like in Dubai Maritime City?

data.answer:
Dubai Maritime City (DMC) offers a unique blend of maritime industry infrastructure and luxurious residential living. Strategically situated between Port Rashid and Dubai Drydocks, DMC provides residents with stunning views of the Arabian Gulf and easy access to both business and recreational activities. 

The community is known for its serene environment, modern amenities, and a strong focus on sustainability. With state-of-the-art infrastructure and green spaces, life in DMC is convenient and high-quality, making it an attractive choice for those seeking a vibrant urban lifestyle in Dubai.

Public Transportation in Dubai Maritime City

Dubai Maritime City is well-served by an efficient public transportation network, ensuring easy connectivity to the rest of the city. The area is linked by several bus routes that connect to major parts of Dubai, including the nearby Al Ghubaiba Metro Station, which is just a 10-minute drive away. 

From there, residents can access the extensive Dubai Metro network, providing quick and easy access to business districts, shopping malls, and tourist attractions. Moreover, taxis and ride-sharing services are readily available, making transportation within and beyond DMC convenient and hassle-free.

Supermarkets in and Near Dubai Maritime City

Residents of Dubai Maritime City have access to a variety of supermarkets to meet their daily needs. Within a short drive, around 10 to 15 minutes, there are several well-known supermarket chains. Choithrams, located about 12 minutes away, offers a wide range of local and international products. 

Spinneys, known for its high-quality groceries and fresh produce, is just a 15-minute drive. Carrefour, located in nearby shopping malls like BurJuman Mall and City Centre Deira, provides a diverse selection of groceries, electronics, and household items, and is approximately a 15-minute drive away. Additionally, Al Maya Supermarket, offering a variety of essentials, is just 10 minutes away, ensuring residents have easy access to all their grocery and household needs without having to travel far.

Shopping Malls in and Near Dubai Maritime City Area

Dubai Maritime City is conveniently located near several prominent shopping malls, offering various retail, dining, and entertainment options. The Dubai Mall, one of the world's largest and most famous shopping malls, is a 20-minute drive away and features over 1,200 retail outlets, various dining options, and numerous entertainment attractions, including an indoor aquarium and an ice rink. 

BurJuman Mall, located in the nearby Bur Dubai area, is a 15-minute drive and offers a mix of high-end and mid-range retail stores and a selection of international restaurants and cafes. Wafi Mall, known for its unique Egyptian-themed architecture, is a 20-minute drive away and provides a luxurious shopping experience. 

Schools and Nurseries in Dubai Maritime City

While there are no schools within DMC, several reputable schools and nurseries are located within a short driving distance.

Little Diamond Nursery, located about 10 minutes away, offers a nurturing environment for early childhood education. Another nearby option is Kids World Nursery, which is approximately a 12-minute drive from DMC and provides a creative and engaging curriculum.

GEMS Winchester School, located in Oud Metha, is about a 15-minute drive away and offers a British curriculum. New Indian Model School, offering the Indian curriculum, is also around 15 minutes away. Additionally, The Indian High School, which provides both Indian and international curricula, is about a 20-minute drive from DMC.

Churches, Temples, and Mosques in and Near Dubai Maritime City

Dubai Maritime City is located near several places of worship, catering to the diverse religious needs of its residents. The Al Mina Mosque is about a 10-minute drive from DMC, while The Grand Mosque in Bur Dubai, known for its impressive architecture and capacity to hold thousands of worshippers, is around 15 minutes away.

St. Mary's Catholic Church, one of the oldest and most prominent churches in Dubai, is about a 15-minute drive away. Holy Trinity Church, which hosts services for various denominations, is also approximately 15 minutes from DMC.

For Hindu residents, the Shiva and Krishna temples in Bur Dubai are about a 20-minute drive away.

Clinics and Hospitals Near Dubai Maritime City Area

For primary healthcare needs, the Aster Clinic in Bur Dubai is about a 10-minute drive away, offering a range of medical services and specialties.

For more comprehensive medical care, the American Hospital Dubai, renowned for its advanced healthcare services and facilities, is approximately a 15-minute drive from DMC. The Iranian Hospital, which provides a wide range of medical and surgical specialties, is also about 15 minutes away.

Dubai Maritime City Location & Nearby Areas

The area enjoys proximity to several key districts and attractions in Dubai. DMC is adjacent to Bur Dubai, one of the city's oldest and most culturally rich areas, known for its historical sites, traditional markets, and vibrant community life. The Dubai Creek, a major historical and commercial hub, is also nearby, offering a glimpse into the city's trading past.

Business Bay, a major commercial district, is also within a 20-minute driving distance, making it convenient for professionals working there.

more_info.question: Things to Do in Dubai Maritime City

data.answer:
Dubai Maritime City (DMC) offers a variety of activities for residents and visitors alike, blending leisure, business, and maritime experiences. You can enjoy the stunning waterfront views and take leisurely walks along the marina, watching the ships and yachts come and go. The area also provides various water-based activities, such as boating and sailing, leveraging its prime location by the Arabian Gulf. 

Restaurants in Dubai Maritime City Free Zone

While Dubai Maritime City itself is still developing its range of dining options, nearby areas offer a plethora of restaurants catering to various tastes. Within a short drive, you can explore dining spots in Bur Dubai and Jumeirah.

Al Ustad Special Kabab in Bur Dubai, about a 10-minute drive, is renowned for its delicious Persian kebabs. Mitra Restaurant in Al Seef, around 12 minutes away, offers a fusion of Indian and Middle Eastern cuisine with beautiful creekside views. For those looking for upscale dining, Al Dawaar Revolving Restaurant in Deira, approximately 15 minutes away, provides an exquisite dining experience with panoramic views of Dubai.

Beaches Near Dubai Maritime City

Dubai Maritime City is conveniently located near some of Dubai's most popular beaches.

Jumeirah Public Beach, a 15-minute drive away, is perfect for sunbathing, swimming, and enjoying various water sports. La Mer, about 20 minutes from DMC, offers a vibrant beach experience with its trendy shops, cafes, and restaurants, along with a family-friendly waterpark. Kite Beach, also approximately 20 minutes away, is a favorite for kite surfers and paddleboarders, providing a lively atmosphere and plenty of beachside activities.

Hotels in Dubai Maritime City

Hyatt Regency Dubai, located about 15 minutes away in Deira, offers luxurious rooms and excellent amenities, including multiple dining options and a wellness center. Grand Hyatt Dubai, roughly a 20-minute drive, provides a resort-like experience with lush gardens, numerous pools, and a variety of international restaurants. For a more boutique experience, Zabeel House by Jumeirah in Al Seef is about a 12-minute drive from DMC and offers stylish rooms and a modern, relaxed atmosphere.

Attractions and Landmarks Near Dubai Maritime City Dubai

Dubai Museum, located in the Al Fahidi Fort in Bur Dubai, is about a 10-minute drive away and offers a fascinating insight into the city’s history and cultural heritage. Al Fahidi Historical Neighbourhood, also nearby, provides a glimpse into Dubai’s past with its restored traditional buildings and museums.
The Dubai Frame, an architectural landmark that offers panoramic views of old and new Dubai, is around a 15-minute drive from DMC. Burj Khalifa and Dubai Mall, two of Dubai’s most famous attractions, are about 20 minutes away, providing a range of entertainment, shopping, and dining experiences.

For those interested in maritime history, The Queen Elizabeth 2 (QE2) floating hotel and museum is located nearby at Port Rashid, just a 10-minute drive from DMC. This iconic ocean liner has been transformed into a unique hotel and attraction, offering a blend of historical charm and modern luxury.

One minor disadvantage of living in Dubai Maritime City (DMC) is the limited availability of immediate amenities and within the development itself, as it is still in the process of being fully developed. Residents might have to travel to nearby districts like Bur Dubai or Jumeirah for a wider range of dining, shopping, and entertainment options. This can be slightly inconvenient for those who prefer having all essential amenities within walking distance. However, with ongoing development, the availability of these amenities will soon be available.

What types of properties are available in Dubai Maritime City?

Dubai Maritime City offers a mix of residential properties including luxury apartments, waterfront villas, and modern townhouses. These properties are designed to cater to different lifestyle needs, with options ranging from cozy one-bedroom units to spacious family homes.

Is Dubai Maritime City suitable for families?

Yes, Dubai Maritime City is suitable for families. While the area is still developing its range of amenities, it offers a serene environment with beautiful waterfront views. Nearby, there are several reputable schools, nurseries, parks, and recreational areas that cater to the needs of families with children.

How is the connectivity and transportation in Dubai Maritime City?

Dubai Maritime City is well-connected to the rest of Dubai through a robust public transportation network. It is serviced by several bus routes, and the nearest metro station, Al Ghubaiba, is just a 10-minute drive away. Additionally, taxis and ride-sharing services are readily available, ensuring convenient transportation options.

What recreational activities are available in Dubai Maritime City?

Residents of Dubai Maritime City can enjoy a variety of recreational activities, particularly those related to the maritime environment. These include boating, sailing, and waterfront promenades. The area also hosts maritime-related events and exhibitions. For more diverse leisure activities, nearby areas like Jumeirah and Downtown Dubai offer beaches, parks, shopping malls, and cultural attractions.

What is Dubai Maritime City's nearest metro station?

The nearest metro station to Dubai Maritime City is Al Ghubaiba Metro Station.

data.content:
Strategically located between Port Rashid and Dubai Drydocks World, Dubai Maritime City is designed to be a comprehensive hub for all maritime-related activities. The area is meticulously planned to support diverse maritime sectors, including shipping, shipbuilding, repair and maintenance, marine equipment, and maritime services.

DMC also offers an array of commercial spaces, like modern office towers and business centers. Many developers have also launched various off plan properties in the area, including waterfront apartments and penthouses.

Dubai Maritime City has been developed with green community standards as part of Dubai Maritime Vision 2023. DMC is linked to Sheikh Zayed Road (E11) through a causeway near Bur Dubai.

nodes.title: Breez
nodes.about:
Breez by Danube Properties is a 60-floor residential tower located in Dubai Maritime City. Designed as a symbol of modern coastal elegance, the development offers fully furnished oceanfront homes that combine contemporary architecture with breathtaking sea views.

Every detail at Breez reflects Danube Properties’ commitment to quality and innovation. With over 40 resort-style amenities, residents can indulge in a lifestyle that’s both active and tranquil, surrounded by panoramic views and world-class facilities.

nodes.title: IL Vento
nodes.about:
IL Vento by Kora Properties is a landmark seafront residence rising elegantly in Dubai Maritime City, offering a resort-style living experience inspired by maritime luxury. Developed by Kora Properties, Apparel Group’s real estate arm, the tower blends timeless Italian-inspired elegance with contemporary architecture curated by Pininfarina. Home to 1–3 bedroom apartments and exclusive penthouses, each residence is framed by floor-to-ceiling windows that open to uninterrupted ocean and skyline views.

Designed for a serene coastal lifestyle, IL Vento features spacious layouts, shaded balconies, and refined interiors that seamlessly connect indoor comfort with the surrounding seascape. Its prime peninsula location places residents minutes away from Port Rashid, J1 Beach, Downtown Dubai, DIFC, and Dubai International Airport, making it an exceptional address for luxury seekers and investors alike.

nodes.title: Kanyon
nodes.about:
Kanyon by Beyond at Dubai Maritime City introduces 412 contemporary residences designed for comfortable, modern living. Located within the Forest District in Maritime City, it offers a selection of 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments surrounded by greenery and thoughtfully crafted outdoor spaces.

Residents enjoy a balanced lifestyle shaped by considered design and thoughtful communal spaces. With a swimming pool, gymnasium, yoga room, landscaped gardens, and a children’s play area, the community blends convenience and recreation while offering strong long-term ROI potential.

nodes.title: Franck Muller Yachting
nodes.about:
Franck Muller Yachting is an iconic branded residential project in Dubai Maritime City, developed by London Gate Real Estate Development. The 30-storey tower offers a refined selection of studio, 1 and 2-bedroom apartments that blend contemporary design with the signature elegance of Franck Muller’s craftsmanship.

Set in a prime waterfront location, Franck Muller Yachting by London Gate offers residents a luxurious lifestyle complemented by world-class features and exclusive amenities. With its exceptional design, strategic location, and brand prestige, the development promises strong ROI potential and long-term value for both investors and end-users.

nodes.title: Jumeirah Peninsula Gardens
nodes.about:
Located in the prestigious Dubai Maritime City, Jumeirah Peninsula Gardens is an exclusive waterfront development by Beyond. Offering a blend of luxury and tranquility, it is designed for those seeking island living within the heart of Dubai. The development features modern residences with access to world-class leisure and wellness facilities.

Residents can indulge in premium lifestyle experiences with access to the fitness centre, infinity pool, and beautifully landscaped gardens. Jumeirah Peninsula Gardens amenities are crafted to elevate everyday living, offering a serene yet vibrant environment. With a strong potential for high ROI, this project is ideal for both investors and end-users.

nodes.title: Soulever
nodes.about:
Soulever by Beyond introduces a new standard of luxury living in Dubai Maritime City, blending innovative architecture with waterfront serenity. The two-tower complex by Beyond Developments features 1, 2 and 3-bedroom apartments, 2-bedroom chalets, 4-bedroom duplexes, and 5-bedroom penthouses designed for discerning lifestyles.

With world-class Soulever by Beyond amenities including a swimming pool, pool deck, wellness studio, and outdoor yoga spaces, residents enjoy comfort and relaxation at every step. Backed by a reputable developer, prime location, and strong ROI potential, this waterfront development stands out as an exclusive residential address in Dubai.
